problem_statement: Let A3 = ({0,1,2,3}, s3, m3) be the idempotent Taylor square algebra on four points with congruence blocks {0,1} and {2,3}, semilattice quotient behavior on the blocks via binary term s3, majority behavior inside each block via ternary term m3, and Taylor-certified by an explicit cyclic term. Decide the Hobby-McKenzie dichotomy: either log a 4-ary 3-edge term coherent with the quotient and verified on all 256 quadruples, or exhibit a minimal smooth loop-free digraph compatible with A3 certifying failure of 3-edge terms and congruence distributivity. Log the congruence, quotient table, two-generated data, and the decisive witness.
